description_expanded: Description Description Gulf Vista rental 8 located in Seacrest Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Bonus - Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* Spacious Balconies* Large Living Area with Smart TV* Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 3 - Full Bed* Half Bathroom* Full Size Washer/Dryer* Grill* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* Sleeps 6 30A Public Beach Access Points ABOUT GULF VISTAGulf Vista on 30A is a charming coastal community offering private beach access and a prime location just minutes from Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Perfect for a relaxing vacation getaway, Gulf Vista provides easy access to sugar-white sand beaches, scenic bike paths, and some of the best dining and shopping along Scenic Highway 30A. AMENITIESPrivate Beach AccessFamily FriendlyConveniently located near Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach ***Guests receive free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. Read more
